sentences.text: The provided Gold Loan FAQ excerpt identifies the product as a gold loan, but it does not state any pre-payment charge for gold loans.

The only in-force pre-payment-charge rule text provided says that, for loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, pre-payment charges must be disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and no undisclosed pre-payment charges may be charged.
The evidence provided does not include a gold-loan FAQ entry or other disclosed charge amount for gold loans, so the applicable pre-payment charge cannot be confirmed from the supplied documents.

missing.searched: Gold Loan FAQ excerpt and the in-force pre-payment-charge disclosure rules for any stated charge amount or rate for gold loans
